name: Lomita City Council

Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
May 4, 2009
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
b.
Flag Salute
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: March 16
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting February and March 2009 Treasury and Investment Report. RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report submitting progress report for public works projects. RECEIVE AND FILE.
h.
Report recommending approval of services agreement to McKenna et al to provide archaeological/paleontological monitoring services for $24,600 in connection with the Cypress Street reservoir. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report accepting donation of 16 ABC fire extinguishers and 14 flashlights from City-Wide Fire Protection, South Bay Fire Extinguishers companies and Pelican Products for CERTS. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report recommending that the city council oppose AB 155 which would require a city to first obtain approval from a state committee before filing for chapter 9 bankruptcy protection. RECOMMEND OPPOSITION TO AB 155.
k.
Report recommending award of contract to T.D. Grogan Construction for $5,519 for the assembly and installation of a third picnic shelter at Lomita Park. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
l.
Report recommending approval of Lomita CERT website content and authorize CERT to place link on city hall page and host the site with PV on the Net. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
m.
Report recommending that the city council send a letter regarding a request from Pete's Place, 2158 Lomita Boulevard, to remove conditions imposed by the Alcoholic Beverage Control. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
n.
Report submitting change orders to construction engineering services contract with Tetra Tech dealing with permitting costs and water production for Cypress Street reservoir. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
o.
Report recommending approval of a "Buy One Get One Free" promotion for the dial-a-ride and dial-a-taxi paratransit programs. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
5.
ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT NO 2009-1 Public hearing on an amendment to the Zoning Ordinance amending Article 30, and deleting Article 31 (A-1 Agriculture—Noncommercial Zone), Article 32 (R-1 Single-Family Residential Zone), Article 33 (RV Residential--Variable Density Zone), Article 35 (Request for Reasonable Accommodation), Article 53 (View Protection), Article 63 (Yards), Article 71 (Modifications) and Sec. 11-1.68.02 (Fences and walls).
Presented by Comm Dev Drtr Sugano.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
6.
AMERICAN RECOVERY & REINVESTMENT ACT Report providing an update on grant funding opportunities dealing with the American Recovery & Reinvestment Act.
Presented by Comm Dev Drtr Sugano.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
